- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3773-3774, 3792-3793 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "Cleanup test artifacts" step turns a failed run-listing request into an empty listing. `|| echo ""` empties `CLEANUP_DISPATCH_REVIEW_RUN_IDS`, and `2>/dev/null` discards the `::error::` text from `_safe_gh_jq`. The loop never runs and the step prints "No active dispatch review runs".
  WHY: After a transient failure (rate limit or 5xx), the queued Phase 3c dispatch run is not cancelled and keeps its `review-gate-notice-<repo>-<pr>` group. The step is fail-soft, so the job result is unaffected, but the message hides the skipped cancel. The reviewer suggests capturing the listing exit status and warning on failure (about 4 lines). It notes that the existing tests stub `_safe_gh_jq` as always succeeding, so a failure case needs a new test.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: wrap the listing in `if ! CLEANUP_DISPATCH_REVIEW_RUN_IDS="$(_safe_gh_jq ... )"; then` and print a warning. Set `CLEANUP_DISPATCH_LIST_FAILED=1`, and print "No active ..." only when that flag is unset. Estimated change: 4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Other checklist sections (security, correctness, concurrency, performance, DB, naming, trust boundary): NONE.
- Task completeness: NONE. Fix 2 is delivered. Fixes 1 and 3 are deferred under AD-1 and AD-2.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3773-3774, 3792-3793 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The run-listing call uses `2>/dev/null || echo ""`, so a transient GitHub API failure yields an empty listing that looks the same as a genuine "no active runs" result. `2>/dev/null` discards the `::error::` diagnostic from `_safe_gh_jq`. Cleanup then prints "No active dispatch review runs on ${BRANCH}" even though the listing never ran. This is also inconsistent with the per-cancel calls (lines 3786-3789), which gate on the API return code and warn on failure.
  WHY: On any transient failure (rate limit, 5xx, network blip, auth timeout), the log shows a green "No active dispatch review runs" line while the queued dispatch review run keeps holding the review-gate concurrency group. This reproduces incident 43283656910. The suggested fix is to capture the listing rc and emit `Warning: could not list dispatch review runs; cleanup may have leaked`, matching the warning pattern at line 3789.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3773-3774, 3792-3793 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed run-list API call cannot be told apart from a genuine "no active runs" result. `_safe_gh_jq` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1385-1399) returns 1, and `2>/dev/null || echo ""` empties `CLEANUP_DISPATCH_REVIEW_RUN_IDS`. The loop never runs, `CLEANUP_DISPATCH_MATCHED` stays 0, and line 3793 prints "No active dispatch review runs on ${BRANCH}". The call is also not wrapped in `gh_retry` (unlike orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1644). The changelog fragment (changelog.d/9418-cleanup-cancel-dispatch-review-run.md) says "every call only warns on failure", but the list call's failure produces no warning.
  WHY: In the incident scenario this PR heals, a transient list failure leaves the stale queued Phase 3c dispatch run uncancelled while the log says there is nothing to cancel, so the leak recurs. The minimal fix (about 4 lines) is to drop `2>/dev/null`, test the substitution's status, and print `Warning: could not list dispatch review runs on ${BRANCH}` instead of "No active dispatch review runs". The existing test test_cancel_block_empty_listing_reports_none stays valid. A failed-list case can be added to tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_cleanup_cancels_dispatch_review.py.
- Task completeness: NONE. Fix 2 is delivered in .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3761-3797 with contract tests and a changelog fragment. Fix 1 is out of scope under AD-1, and fix 3 was declined under AD-2.
